reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly supports that SRO breakdown creates softer zones and governs deformation mechanisms in single-crystal CrCoNi under cyclic loading, but it does not address the key premises that pre-deformation annealing can control SRO in multilayers or that this mechanism governs progressive plastic deformation under sustained (creep) loading in a multilayer geometry.
premises: SRO breakdown creates softer zones that promote dislocation activity and planar fault formation in CrCoNi
SRO governs the sequence of deformation mechanisms in CrCoNi
SRO evolution can be controlled by pre-deformation annealing
SRO breakdown is observable via energy-filtered 4D-STEM
SRO-mediated rejuvenation drives progressive plastic deformation under sustained loading
